edition.note: the at-home first stage of the full Core, same item ids

intro.lead: This is the first step of The Core: the prep. You fill it in at home, on your own, at your pace, and along the way you get to know the 12 brand archetypes. Everything you write here goes straight into The Core, so in the studio we skip the basics and get to the decisions that matter.
promise: About 40 minutes, an hour at most. Each module tells you how long it takes.
We save as you go, on this device and on our side. Close it any time and pick up where you left off, from the same link.
There are no wrong answers. If something stops you, skip it: we'll work on it together in the studio.

title: The archetypes,
at your pace
modules.why: Twelve ways of being a brand. Read them, flip the cards to see what each would look like at yours, and pick the ones you recognise yourself in. We settle the final mix together.

items.label: The 12 archetypes
items.help: It isn't a test. Pick as many as you like; a line of why helps us a lot in the studio.

archetypes.name: Innocent
archetypes.motto: Life can be simple and good.
archetypes.line: Optimistic, honest, nothing to hide. Sees the good before the problem and helps people breathe easier.
archetypes.desire: to live simply and calmly, with good things around
archetypes.fear: getting it wrong, making things complicated, being punished for a choice
archetypes.asBrand: promises the decision is easy and that it will all be fine. No small print.
archetypes.lead: The brand promises simplicity and calm. People come to you because you never make things complicated.
archetypes.accent: a gentle light and a promise of honesty, which make the rest easier to believe
archetypes.voice: short sentences, plain words, zero jargon
archetypes.visual: lots of air, light, clean colours, soft shapes
archetypes.experience: few clear steps, no surprises at the end
archetypes.risk: it can feel naive or too sweet without hard proof behind it

archetypes.name: Explorer
archetypes.line: Curious, restless in the good way, always with a road in mind. Looks for the place where it feels most alive.
archetypes.desire: the freedom to find out who it is through the places it passes
archetypes.fear: being stuck, being bored, living a life that isn't its own
archetypes.gift: authenticity and the nerve to leave
archetypes.asBrand: pulls you out of the routine and shows you a place you hadn't thought of.
archetypes.lead: The brand is an invitation to set off. People come for the freedom to choose differently.
archetypes.accent: curiosity and an appetite for new places, which keep the brand moving
archetypes.voice: verbs of movement, open questions, the tone of a friend who has already been there
archetypes.experience: guided discovery, routes, recommendations that surprise
archetypes.risk: it can feel restless, hard to tie to a home and to roots

archetypes.name: Sage
archetypes.motto: The truth will set you free.
archetypes.line: Calm, well read, with the patience of a good teacher. Helps people see clearly before they decide.
archetypes.desire: to understand the world and help others understand it too
archetypes.fear: being fooled, being wrong, talking without knowing
archetypes.asBrand: is the guide who did the homework. It explains, it doesn't sell.
archetypes.lead: The brand is the guide who knows. People come for clarity in a big decision.
archetypes.accent: arguments, data and the quiet confidence of someone who did the homework
archetypes.visual: order, careful typography, maps and data laid out well
archetypes.risk: it can turn cold or preachy, too much head and too little heart

archetypes.name: Hero
archetypes.motto: Where there's a will, there's a way.
archetypes.line: Brave, disciplined, built for high stakes. Makes hard things look possible and pushes others further.
archetypes.desire: to prove its worth through an act of courage
archetypes.asBrand: helps you win a fight that matters to you.
archetypes.lead: The brand is about making it. People come because you help them win something big.
archetypes.accent: energy and drive, with a little extra adrenaline
archetypes.experience: clear goals, visible progress, moments of victory
archetypes.risk: it can feel aggressive or competitive where people are looking for warmth

archetypes.name: Rebel
archetypes.motto: Rules are made to be broken.
archetypes.line: A nonconformist, honest to the point of discomfort. Says what others only think and builds the alternative.
archetypes.desire: to change what no longer works, even if it bothers people
archetypes.fear: being powerless, ordinary, swallowed by the system
archetypes.gift: radical freedom and the nerve to say no
archetypes.asBrand: stands against the way the industry does things today.
archetypes.lead: The brand stands against the way things are done today. People come because they've had enough.
archetypes.accent: a sharp edge and the nerve to name what's wrong with the industry
archetypes.experience: a clear alternative to the system, with rules of its own
archetypes.risk: it can scare off exactly the people who want trust and safety

archetypes.name: Magician
archetypes.line: Visionary, charismatic, tuned to the moment when everything clicks. Turns a vague wish into something real.
archetypes.desire: to understand how the world works and change it
archetypes.fear: unintended consequences, magic that turns against it
archetypes.asBrand: promises the moment when everything falls into place, as if by magic.
archetypes.lead: The brand promises a change. People come for the moment when everything clicks.
archetypes.accent: a touch of wonder, the feeling that something special is happening
archetypes.visual: light, reveal moments, details that surprise
archetypes.experience: matches that feel like magic, well staged wow moments
archetypes.risk: it can overpromise, and magic without proof looks like a trick

archetypes.name: Everyman
archetypes.line: Friendly, down to earth, no airs. The neighbour you can count on, who talks like you and keeps the door open.
archetypes.desire: to belong, to be accepted as it is
archetypes.fear: being left out, looking like it thinks it's better than it is
archetypes.asBrand: is one of us. It makes you feel among your own.
archetypes.lead: The brand belongs to everyone. People come because they feel among their own.
archetypes.accent: a neighbour's warmth and a door that's always open
archetypes.visual: real people, friendly colours, nothing pretentious
archetypes.experience: easy to reach, no barriers, an open community
archetypes.risk: it can feel ordinary, hard to tell apart or to charge more for

archetypes.name: Lover
archetypes.line: Sensory, warm, attentive to detail. Creates closeness and makes people feel wanted and seen.
archetypes.gift: passion, gratitude, an eye for beauty
archetypes.asBrand: is about how you feel: close, chosen, at home.
archetypes.lead: The brand is about closeness and pleasure. People come for the way it makes them feel.
archetypes.accent: warmth, the senses and an eye for the details that make a place feel like yours
archetypes.voice: sensory, intimate, in the second person
archetypes.experience: personal attention, rituals, moments you remember
archetypes.risk: it can slide into too sweet or too exclusive, and next to dating it can read as ambiguous

archetypes.name: Jester
archetypes.line: Playful, spontaneous, with a good sense of humour. Lightens hard moments and gathers people around a joke.
archetypes.desire: to live in the moment, with joy and play
archetypes.asBrand: makes getting there more fun than arriving.
archetypes.lead: The brand is joy. People come because things are more fun with you.
archetypes.accent: humour and play, which make the brand easier to love
archetypes.risk: it can undercut trust in a big decision, like buying a home

archetypes.name: Caregiver
archetypes.line: Generous, protective, endlessly patient. Looks after people like family and never leaves them on their own.
archetypes.fear: selfishness, ingratitude, not being able to help
archetypes.asBrand: is the steady hand that holds yours from the first question to the keys.
archetypes.lead: The brand is the steady hand. People come because they know someone is looking after them.
archetypes.accent: care and safety, the feeling that you're not alone in the decision
archetypes.visual: rounded shapes, warm and calm colours, people together
archetypes.experience: support from start to finish, always reachable, patient
archetypes.risk: it can feel too soft or protective, with no personality of its own

archetypes.name: Creator
archetypes.motto: If you can imagine it, you can build it.
archetypes.line: Imaginative, a perfectionist, proud of the craft. Sees what doesn't exist yet and builds it with care.
archetypes.desire: to make something of lasting value
archetypes.asBrand: builds something that never existed and invites you to make it together.
archetypes.lead: The brand builds something new. People come for the vision and for the way it's made.
archetypes.accent: care for the craft and a vision you can see in the details
archetypes.voice: visionary, precise about details, proud of work done well
archetypes.visual: systems, careful design, sketches, the process in plain sight
archetypes.experience: co-creation, curation, things made to measure
archetypes.risk: it can become perfectionist or too wrapped up in itself

archetypes.name: Ruler
archetypes.line: Self-assured, organised, with high standards. Creates order, makes decisions and sets the rules of the game.
archetypes.desire: control, stability, a thriving and well run community
archetypes.asBrand: is the standard. The strict selection is the promise itself.
archetypes.lead: The brand is the standard. People come for quality, order and status.
archetypes.accent: rigour and a high standard, which build trust
archetypes.voice: assured, sober, few words and well chosen
archetypes.experience: strict selection, premium access, a flawless process
archetypes.risk: it can feel cold, distant or exclusive

innocent.headline: Good, simple, no surprises.
innocent.listing: One package, the price in plain sight, nothing extra.
innocent.experience: An open day with simple answers to any question.
innocent.site: One clear question and three good options under it.
innocent.never: hide a cost or complicate a simple choice.

explorer.headline: There's more out there.
explorer.listing: A package that gets you out of the routine: something you haven't tried yet.
explorer.experience: A day somewhere new, with someone who knows it well.
explorer.site: A map to explore before the product list.
explorer.never: sell everyone the same thing, the same way.

sage.headline: Before you choose, understand.
sage.listing: The offer comes with an honest comparison and the data in plain sight.
sage.experience: A 90-minute workshop on how to choose well.
sage.site: A guide with answers that have been checked.

hero.headline: You'll get there. We'll help.
hero.listing: A plan with a deadline and a clear result, guaranteed.
hero.experience: A 21-day challenge, with your progress in plain sight.
hero.site: The steps to the result, with your progress in plain sight.
hero.never: leave a client stuck, with no answer.

rebel.headline: The industry has done it this way for 20 years. We don't.
rebel.listing: No small print and no “limited offer”. Just the price.
rebel.experience: An evening about what's broken in the industry and how we do it differently.
rebel.site: A manifesto instead of a catalogue.

magician.headline: Tell us what you want. The rest falls into place.
magician.listing: An offer that shapes itself around what you said you want.
magician.experience: The moment the client first sees the result, carefully staged.
magician.site: A quiz that turns into your recommendation at the end.
magician.never: promise a change it can't deliver.

everyman.headline: For people like you.
everyman.listing: A fair price, explained the way a friend would.
everyman.experience: A get-together open to anyone, no dress code.
everyman.site: Stories from real clients, with their own photos.
everyman.never: show off or make anyone feel small.

lover.headline: Made for you.
lover.listing: An offer built on the details that matter to you.
lover.experience: A dinner for 12 clients, with care in every detail.
lover.site: Warm images, textures, people up close.
lover.never: treat a client like a number.

jester.headline: Nothing is that serious. Not even this.
jester.listing: The “No Hassle” package, explained with a good joke.
jester.experience: A quiz night with clients, with ridiculous prizes.
jester.site: Microcopy with a sense of humour and a little game.
jester.never: joke about money or hard decisions.

caregiver.headline: You're not alone in this.
caregiver.listing: We stay with you from the first question to well after delivery.
caregiver.experience: A month of support after delivery, with a real person on the phone.
caregiver.site: “How can we help?” and an answer the same day.
caregiver.never: disappear once the contract is signed.

creator.headline: Let's build something that's never existed.
creator.listing: An offer made to measure, with the process in plain sight.
creator.experience: A co-creation workshop with the first clients.
creator.site: Sketches, process, choices: how it gets made.
creator.never: deliver something generic, off the production line.

ruler.headline: The standard, not an option.
ruler.listing: A strict selection, by appointment only.
ruler.site: A small portfolio, with the standards published.
ruler.never: take on anything just for the volume.

title: The website
and the rest
modules.why: Your first website doesn't have to do everything. It has to do three things well in its first three months.

items.label: What does the website need to do in its first 3 months? Put it in order.
Domain and social accounts you already own
Deadlines: when does it need to be ready?
suggestions: No rush, we want it right

items.label: What does success look like in 6 months? Three numbers to watch.

agenda.title: Coffee and ground rules
agenda.goal: What we do today and what we leave with: The Core, the archetype mix and the profiles.

agenda.title: The foundation
agenda.goal: What we keep from what you've already said. How much of the brand is you.

agenda.title: People and positioning
agenda.goal: First clients, who we turn away, the positioning sentence and the X factor.

agenda.title: Personality and archetype
agenda.goal: Two archetypes and a percentage. The referee for design decisions.

agenda.title: Values and attributes
agenda.goal: We vote. Three values with “always / never”, attributes 3 + 3.

agenda.title: Voice and visuals
agenda.goal: How it sounds and how it feels. What we avoid at all costs.

agenda.title: Architecture and website
agenda.goal: The order of priorities, the sub-brand calls, what the site does in 3 months.

agenda.title: Writing The Core
agenda.goal: One sentence. What you offer, to whom, in what culture, in what voice, what it gives them, how they feel.

core.label: In what culture
core.hint: the place, the pace, the values

core.label: In what voice
core.hint: three words for how you sound

core.label: X factor
core.hint: what you promise and others can't

done.title: Prep done. See you in the studio.
done.body: We have everything. We'll read it before we meet, and when we start working you'll find your answers already in The Core, right where they belong. The rest we do together, over a coffee, at Olari 9.
